How it works

From idea to a working team in three moves.

See full walkthrough
01

Define your agents

In Agent Studio, give each agent a name, a role, a personality and the tools they need. Like writing a job description — your agent remembers it forever.

02

Compose your team

In Team Studio, drag agents onto your canvas. Choose a topology — Group Chat, Manager-Led, Hierarchical. Structure your team like a real org.

03

Run or automate

Launch your team for dynamic collaboration — or build a deterministic workflow that runs the same way, every single time. You choose the mode that fits the job.

Three studios

One platform, three ways to build.

Whether you're defining an agent, organising a team, or automating a process — there's a studio for that.

Agent Studio

Define your agents

Name, role, tools, instructions, personality. Configure each agent once — then reuse them across any team or workflow.

Reusable · configurable
Team Studio

Organise your team

Drag agents onto a visual canvas. Connect them. Choose a topology that defines authority, collaboration style and delegation. Like drawing an org chart — that actually works.

Visual · flexible · powerful
Workflow Studio

Automate your processes

Build step-by-step workflows that run exactly the same way, every time. Sequential nodes, conditional branches, scheduled runs. Deterministic by design.

Deterministic · repeatable
Team topologies

Built the way real teams work.

Most tools pass data between steps. Agentivity gives each agent a role, an authority level, and a real collaboration structure. Your agents don't just receive instructions — they know their place in the team, who they report to, and how decisions get made. Not wired. Organised.

Not task routing. Real team structure.
Group Chat collaborative

Everyone contributes — freely, openly, building on each other's ideas. Like a brainstorm where the best thinking wins, not the loudest voice.

Manager-Led coordinated

One agent leads, coordinates and delegates. Tasks flow down, results flow up. Your virtual project manager — without the status updates.

Hierarchical structured

Clear chain of authority. Each level approves before the next begins. Built for quality control, multi-stage review, and compliance-sensitive workflows.

Sequential predictable

One after another. Reliable, auditable, always the same. The backbone of your repeatable, scheduled business processes.

Workflow Studio

AI when you need judgment.
Workflows when you need your own rules.

Some tasks cannot afford variation. A weekly report. A client deliverable. A compliance check. A content pipeline. In Workflow Studio, you define the process exactly — every step, every branch, every output format. Your agents follow it to the letter. No improvisation. No interpretation. Just results.

When consistency is non-negotiable.
Guaranteed output

You define what you'll receive. Your agents deliver exactly that — every run, without exception. Same structure, same format, same quality.

Scheduled or triggered

Run every Monday at 6am, on a file upload, on a webhook. Your workflow starts exactly when you need it — without you lifting a finger.

Fully auditable

Every step logged, every decision traceable. Know exactly what ran, when, and why — and prove it when it counts.
